job.title: Data Entry Operator
job.description:
Data Entry Operators & Team Leaders – Launceston (Election Project)
  
We're recruiting a large team of Data Entry Operators and Team Leaders to support the upcoming Local Government Election with the Tasmanian Electoral Commission.
  
This is a short-term, high-volume project based in Launceston, working as part of a structured team to accurately process ballot paper data during the election period.
If you're reliable, detail-focused and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, we'd like to hear from you.
  
About the roles
You'll be part of a dedicated data entry centre, working to process large volumes of information quickly and accurately. Roles are available as Data Entry Operators and Team Leaders, with Team Leaders also supporting supervision and workflow across small teams.
This is a structured environment with clear expectations, on-site support, and a strong focus on accuracy and consistency.
  
Key dates
Election Event:
  • Tuesday 27 October 2026 (afternoon/evening shift) – 3.00pm to 10.30pm
  • Wednesday 28 October 2026 through to early November 2026 (anticipated)
Available shifts include:
  • 1st Shift – 7.15am to 2.45pm
  • 2nd Shift – 3.00pm to 10.30pm
Shifts are approximately 7 hours with a break, across both daytime and evening options.
  
We're ideally looking for people available across the full election period.
  
About you
We're looking for people who can work in a fast, repetitive environment without losing focus. You'll need to be comfortable sitting at a workstation for extended periods and working as part of a team.
  
To be considered, you will need:
  • Strong data entry skills with a focus on speed and accuracy
  • The ability to meet minimum standards (around 7,000 keystrokes per hour with 90% accuracy)
  • Good attention to detail and consistency
  • Reliable availability across the project dates
  • A professional approach and ability to follow instructions
All workers must also be politically neutral and willing to complete the required declarations prior to commencing employment.
  
What’s on offer
  • Short-term project with clear timelines
  • Structured team environment with support on-site
  • Opportunity to be involved in an important statewide democratic process
  • Casual hourly rates in line with the Tasmanian State Service Award
  
How the process works
Successful applicants will complete a short screening process, including a data entry skills assessment and availability check. This assessment helps ensure you're set up for success in the role.
If you're interested, apply now with your CV. Given the volume of roles, suitable candidates will be progressed quickly.

Pub Banc Group Impacted Employee - Rapid Response Skills Initiative (RRSI) & Career Connector Registration 
 
Register here for Career Connector support to access the Rapid Response Skills Initiative (RRSI) that provides up to $3,000 of funding for Training for employees impacted by business closure, downsizing or retrenchment. 

Funded by the Tasmanian Government, Jobs Tasmania.

That training could be for Re-skilling, Work Related Tickets and Certifications to support and enhance the employability of workers that have been made redundant within the last 12 months. 

The Career Connector service will connect you to personalised Career Support to improve your employability with access to RRSI funded training and a Free Jobs Matching Service.  Career Connector provides advice with Training, connects you to the Network of Regional Local Jobs Hubs, relevant Service Providers and supports you into Employment Opportunities to re-establish your career. 
 
To be eligible, you must meet all of the below criteria: 
  • have lost Casual, Full-time or Part-time work in the last 12 months due to Business Closure, Business Downsizing or Retrenchment
  • be an Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident with a Tasmanian Residential address
  • provide written evidence of job loss, redundancy or retrenchment (a Separation Certificate indicating Redundancy or Email/ Written Evidence of Redundancy)
  • If you were employed by Local, State or Australian Government or Government Department, Business or Government Enterprise, you may not be eligible for RRSI funded training.

job.title: Senior Manager
job.description:
Senior Accountant / Team Leader


Company overview

Searson Buck is pleased to be recruiting on behalf of an established, client‑focused financial services firm supporting privately owned businesses. The organisation takes a considered, quality‑led approach to its work and is known for building long‑term relationships across a broad and varied client base.

Why the role exists

This role has been created to strengthen technical review and leadership capacity within the Tax and Accounting advisory team. It will support ongoing client demand while helping to maintain consistency, develop team capability, and uphold high standards of technical quality.

The role

This position blends hands‑on accounting work with day‑to‑day team leadership and support, while offering scope to take on greater responsibility over time.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Reviewing and overseeing the preparation of financial statements and tax returns across a range of entity types
  • Supporting and supervising accountants at different levels, ensuring work is accurate, complete, and compliant before final sign‑off
  • Providing technical guidance and on‑the‑job coaching to build confidence and consistency within the team
  • Assisting with workflow planning and task allocation to meet agreed deadlines
  • Contributing to technical problem‑solving across tax, compliance, and structuring matters
  • Assisting with internal reviews, planning discussions, or advisory support where needed
Systems and environment
  • Practice management and document workflow tools
  • SMSF and compliance software
  • Microsoft Office, with a strong working knowledge of Excel
What we're looking for

This role will suit an experienced public practice accountant who values technical accuracy, structure, and supporting the development of others.
You will bring:
  • Several years' experience in Australian public practice
  • Strong technical knowledge across tax compliance for companies, trusts, individuals, and SMSFs
  • Experience reviewing work or providing supervision within an accounting team
  • CA or CPA qualification (completed or close to completion)
  • Solid experience using Xero and cloud‑based accounting systems
  • A methodical working style with a high level of attention to detail
The working environment
  • A well‑established and stable accounting practice with progression 
  • Clear workflows and defined areas of responsibility
  • A collaborative team environment with strong technical support
  • Flexible working arrangements, including remote or hybrid options
Remuneration

A salary range of $110,000-$140,000 plus benefits
 
Next steps

job.description:
Are you a motivated sales professional who enjoys building relationships and creating tailored solutions for customers? Do you want to be part of an industry that's shaping a sustainable future while offering outstanding earning potential?

  • Meet with residential and commercial customers to understand their energy needs.

As demand for renewable energy continues to grow, this is an exciting opportunity to build a rewarding career with a company committed to innovation, customer service, and employee success.
